silo_atrium.purpose: Shared vertical landmark around upper-to-middle return bridge; sealed observation glazing shows the descent from upper gallery before shortcut release. No additional actors/items/objectives or bypass route.

structural_connections.policy: Broad shared ungated mandatory connector after anchor A; offset cover preserves original centre route. Player flanks only; no claim of coordinated enemy navigation.

actor_overrides.reason: Supported high ledge exposes diagonal into specimens and crossfire;10.44m horizontal to test stance.

lane_clearance.enemy_navigation: Original centre path physicallyclear; flanks playerchoice only. Machine shrunk depth6→4 and offset z43.25 by root-approved navigation fallback.

risks: Fresh contact/stair and real combat tests required; ledge changes ordinary encounter exposure but no mandatory all-clear or actor count.
